title: Ocean Scene 4 — Reef Story Actions
purpose: Longer sentences and linked observations in one shared reef scene.

sentenceModels: The octopus is opening the treasure chest.
The hermit crab is looking at the shells.
The starfish is on the rock.
The seahorse is next to the coral.

adultSupport.focus: Encourage Basti to make two-part and three-part sentences about who is doing what and where.
starterPrompts: Can you tell me where the starfish is?
Which animal is near the treasure chest?
Can you make a longer sentence?
expansionPrompts: Tell me two things about the turtle.
Which shells are big and small?
What might the hermit crab choose next?

visualAudit: One turtle eating seaweed in the centre.
One octopus beside an open treasure chest on the right.
One hermit crab near multiple shells on the lower left.
Two fish swimming together and one seahorse watching.
